 Dustin May Reportedly Lands White Sox Contract, Will Leave WS Champion Brewers in MLB FA
 Adam Wells Nov 17, 2026 The Milwaukee Brewers have lost another free agent with Dustin May reportedly set to join the Chicago White Sox. 
 Per Robert Murray of FanSided, May has agreed to terms on a three-year deal worth just over $50 million with the White Sox. 
 This article will be updated soon to provide more information and analysis.
